answer: An hostile operator hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The glacier counter is kept in bridge and horizon shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 871 identities multiplies that fee by 714 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
